description: Details required by Condition 5 (Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP)) of planning permission PP/22/01210 (Construction of single storey basement with front and rear lightwells under footprint of house and part of front and rear gardens. Replacement of lower ground floor rear extension and construction of upper ground floor rear extension. Enlargement of lower ground floor side addition and construction of upper ground floor side addition. Reconstruction of front boundary wall and reinstatement of bottle balustrading. Removal of garage in rear garden (north side) and relocation of off-street parking area and pavement crossover to south side of garden)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
